metaDescription: Kevin asks why the Cybertruck bomber, Matthew Livelsberger, wrote about anti-gravity and China, whether his manifesto is real or a psyop.
summary: Kevin asks what the man who allegedly blew himself up in a Cybertruck outside Trump Tower on January 1, 2025 was trying to warn about. Whether the manifesto and emails sent to special forces are real or manufactured, Kevin says the question stays the same: why was the man talking about anti-gravity, China, and what Kevin describes as an alien-technology Cold War with China.
